data_sources: EIA-930 hourly demand, net generation by fuel and interchange for ERCOT (BA code ERCO), EIA bulk six-month files, 2024
EPA eGRID2023 rev2 plant data (PLNT23 + GEN23): ERCOT fossil plant capacity, heat rate, CO2 rate and names
EIA API v2 monthly Texas fuel cost for power plants (coal and gas: Electric Power sector 98; oil: sector 1)
ERCOT NP3-965-ER 60-day SCED disclosure: modeled wind and solar curtailment (HSL minus base point), validated against ERCOT NP4-732/737

Forecast: local gradient-boosted model on EIA-930 history, issued 00:00 CST on the day (day-ahead demand, wind, solar; Chalk credentials pending); inputs also include ERCOT's own wind and solar forecasts (NP4-732/737, latest posting before the issue time) and archived GFS weather forecasts (lead >= 48 h)

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com/, CC BY 4.0): archived GFS forecasts from the Previous Runs API (100 m wind, solar radiation, 2 m temperature) at capacity-weighted ERCOT wind and solar sites and 4 load centers
CAMPD validation skipped (api.data.gov key pending); validation (b) uses EIA-930 fuel mix x eGRID emission factors
Simulator calibrated on 248 training days, validated on 104 held-out days (2024)
Illustrative defaults: carbon price $50/t, payout pool $100,000, background flexible load 10% of forecast peak
